profile.name: Swapnil Mukherjee
profile.title: Technical Consultant @ Okta
profile.headline: I build the identity layer behind modern apps — from CIAM at scale to Auth0 for AI agents.
profile.shortBio: Technical Consultant at Okta helping enterprises ship secure CIAM with Auth0 — including the new identity patterns AI agents demand.
profile.about: I'm a Technical Consultant at Okta, focused on Auth0 for customer identity (CIAM) and the emerging space of identity for AI agents. Before Okta I led CIAM engineering at Fifth Third Bank, where I shipped the end-to-end Auth0 → Ping migration for the Newline commercial banking platform with zero unplanned downtime. Earlier, as Cardinal Health's Okta SME, I federated 100+ apps and operated workforce identity for 22,000+ users in a regulated healthcare environment. My day-to-day lives in OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, JavaScript-based identity logic (Actions, Hooks, Workflows), and Terraform-driven CI/CD — all aligned to Zero Trust.
profile.availability: Open to consulting conversations and CIAM architecture reviews.

highlights.label: Apps federated
highlights.detail: B2E, B2B, B2C across Okta, Auth0, Ping

experience.summary: Implementing and optimizing Auth0 for customer identity — and helping customers design secure identity patterns for AI agents and agentic workflows.
highlights: Partner with customers to implement and optimize Auth0 for CIAM use cases across web, mobile, SPA, and API workloads.
SME for Auth0 for AI Agents — advise customers on secure identity patterns for emerging AI and agentic workflows.
Provide guidance on Universal Login, Organizations, Actions, MFA, Attack Protection, RBAC, and social/enterprise IdP integrations.
Drive customer onboarding, architecture reviews, deployment planning, configuration guidance, and troubleshooting across Auth0 environments.
Advise on OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML patterns; troubleshoot tenant configuration, login flows, token behavior, extensibility, and federation.
Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Product to unblock customer challenges and drive adoption.

experience.summary: CIAM engineer for the Newline commercial banking platform. Set up and owned the Auth0 tenant in production, then later architected the end-to-end migration to Ping Identity with zero unplanned downtime.
highlights: Set up and owned the Auth0 tenant in production for Newline — tenant configuration, custom domains, application onboarding, and day-two operations for external customers and internal staff.
Designed and operated SSO/MFA journeys with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML on Auth0 first and Ping Identity later, aligned to Zero Trust and the bank's internal security standards.

Architected the end-to-end migration from Auth0 to Ping Identity / PingDirectory — gap analysis, attribute and claim mapping, schema design, user profile migration, application re-onboarding, and cutover testing — with zero unplanned downtime and no customer-facing regressions.

Built and maintained custom Auth0 Actions, Rules, and Hooks plus equivalent Ping policies and flows in JavaScript and REST APIs for token enrichment, registration, credential recovery, and step-up auth.
Implemented CI/CD for identity config using GitHub, Jenkins, and Terraform — version-controlled, auditable, and approval-gated promotions across environments.
Refined joiner–mover–leaver logic and access patterns with HR, security, and app teams, reducing access discrepancies, CIAM incidents, and audit findings.

experience.summary: Okta SME for a regulated healthcare enterprise. Operated SSO for 22,000+ identities and federated 100+ apps with Active Directory and Okta.
highlights: Okta subject matter expert and IAM platform engineer for 22,000+ workforce identities across on-prem and cloud apps.
Led 8 engineers through migrating legacy on-prem applications to Okta-based identity services — federating 100+ B2E, B2B, and B2C apps.
Operated SailPoint IdentityIQ for account aggregation, connector configuration, and joiner–mover–leaver workflows across AD, Okta, and key enterprise systems.
Partnered with CyberArk and SailPoint teams to define privileged access patterns, reducing unmanaged and orphaned admin access.
Administered Linux/Red Hat servers and proxy infra underpinning the IAM stack; automated upgrade routines that stabilized SSO during change windows.
Deployed and tuned MFA / adaptive MFA across legacy and cloud platforms aligned to SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.

experience.summary: Built JavaScript and Python automation for internal network tools — my first taste of secure API design and credential handling.
highlights: Built JS and Python automation scripts and internal APIs to streamline deployment and environment configuration for internal network tools.
Designed early routines for logging, health checks, credential handling, and access control that still inform my IAM engineering work.

projects.title: TripShare
projects.summary: Smart carpooling platform with route-matching algorithms and full-stack user management.
projects.description: End-to-end platform that matches travelers with overlapping itineraries to cut cost and emissions. Built user registration, trip-matching, and a CMS-backed admin layer; layered in market-research-driven personas and a CI/CD pipeline for smooth deploys.

projects.title: FAST Firmware Fuzzer
projects.summary: Advanced fuzzing framework that surfaces blind spots in firmware specifications and legacy systems.
projects.description: Evolved the SAFIREFUZZ framework into a fuzzer that fuses specification, code, and test-suite signals to expose SPEC blind spots in firmware. Resolved core bugs and added legacy-system integrations.

projects.title: Pizzeria Manager
projects.summary: Java + SQL backend simulating store operations, inventory, and order processing.
projects.description: OO-designed Java framework with a structured SQL schema for a simulated pizza chain — modular, scalable, and capable of handling multiple order types and inventory flows.

projects.title: DROWN Attack
projects.summary: Executed the DROWN attack against SSLv2 servers to recover keys and demonstrate protocol risk.
projects.description: Performed a full DROWN (Decrypting RSA with Obsolete and Weakened eNcryption) assessment: brute-forced SSLv2 to recover the server's private key, then implemented mitigation strategies.

projects.title: Space Hangman
projects.summary: Flask + HTML5 web game that wires multiple external APIs into a celestial Hangman.
projects.description: Reimagined Hangman with a space theme. Flask backend, HTML5/CSS frontend, and several external APIs woven in to keep gameplay dynamic.

projects.title: System Monitoring Tool
projects.summary: Python CLI for real-time tracking of CPU, memory, and network metrics with anomaly alerts.
projects.description: Built around psutil for collection and matplotlib for live visualization, the tool surfaces CPU load, memory pressure, and network activity — with alerting for anomalous behavior.

projects.title: VoiceRx
projects.summary: Voice-driven EMR interface using Amazon Alexa to automate clinical data entry.
projects.description: An Alexa-powered voice UI for Electronic Medical Records that automates data entry and updates so clinicians can interact with EMRs via voice — streamlining workflows and reducing administrative burden.

projects.title: HealthFit
projects.summary: Wellness app providing personalized daily caloric targets via REST APIs.
projects.description: Python + REST application that recommends daily caloric intake based on a user's weight management goals, backed by research-grounded heuristics and OAuth-secured endpoints.

projects.title: TweetFeel
projects.summary: NLP sentiment engine using RNNs to extract emotional structure from tweets.
projects.description: End-to-end NLP pipeline: text preprocessing, embeddings, and recurrent neural networks to surface emotional structure from tweet streams.

projects.title: Neural Style Transfer
projects.summary: Deep-learning app that fuses content and style images for art and therapeutic use.
projects.description: Implemented neural style transfer in Python — combining a content image with the style of a reference image via deep networks and optimization — with explorations into therapeutic applications.

projects.title: IoT Home Automation
projects.summary: Java-based NodeMCU firmware enabling remote control of traditional appliances.
projects.description: NodeMCU + Java firmware that brings legacy appliances onto the network at low cost — a take on accessible smart-home retrofitting.

projects.title: Fraud Detection
projects.summary: ML pipeline using K-Nearest Neighbour tuned for highly imbalanced credit-transaction data.
projects.description: Built a KNN-based fraud detector with custom feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and tailored distance metrics. Evaluated with precision-recall curves and confusion matrices to maximize recall.
